customers_say: Customers find the water purifier's installation process very good, with knowledgeable installation engineers, and appreciate its premium appearance, smart technology, and thorough explanation of functions. The water tastes good without metallic or chemical aftertaste, and customers like its features, with one noting the information parameters of different parts. While some customers say it functions well, others report it stops working after a few days, and opinions on value are mixed, with some finding it worth the money while others regret their purchase.

reviews.title: Installation and product
reviews.body: Extremely happy with the water purifier installation service. The technician vijay was professional and explained everything clearly. The installation was done neatly without any hassle. Overall, a smooth and satisfactory experience. Highly recommended!!

reviews.title: Value and suggest to buy everyone
reviews.body: Item is good and working fine. Very good water purifier. Installation also done very quick

reviews.author: Amazon Customer
reviews.title: Good product
reviews.body: Lokesh did an excellent job with the water purifier installation. He explained everything in detail and very clearly, including how to use and maintain the purifier. He was professional, patient, and helpful throughout the process. Very satisfied with the installation and service. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Amazon Customer
reviews.title: Good product, but packaging could be better
reviews.body: This was an exchange order for a 15-year-old Aquaguard. The delivery process could have been smoother but the main concern was the condition of the packaging; it was in very poor shape and initially made me worried about the product. Thankfully, the unit itself was intact and works as expected. The installation engineer was knowledgeable, professional, and explained everything clearly. Overall, a good experience with the product and installation, but the packaging could definitely be improved.

reviews.author: Pranab
reviews.title: Superb product my Atomberg. The first adaptible RO/UV filter. And No AMC
reviews.body: It's been an year since I bought this filter. Pros: 1. The adaptible system of RO /UV: The filter decides on the basis of input water TDS if it requires RO or not. We don't need RO water regularly which discards a lot of water while purifying. Saves a lot of water. Our society gets tanker water only in extreme summers. RO got activated only then. Best part, the filter has taste enhancer, which changes the taste of hard water too. Compared it with a friend's RO. You can manually override and switch RO On continuously too. Keeps the TDS level below the level we select through its app in UV mode.
